items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So, I played against Thelma Carpenter and Teddy Wilson.

ctx.x: ’54.’55. George Gewee (?) said I called and asked for the job, you know. So, he gave me $500, I said, “Oh, I’ll make this due.” He said, “Oh, you gotta pay your men out of it.” I said, “That’s alright too.” So, I played against Thelma Carpenter and Teddy Wilson. And Thelma
Carpenter took all the time. I said, “You can take all night, it ain’t gonna make no difference.” So I got on there and stopped that show cold.
